viewer.cancelled: Cancelled. Starting the engine again: about 10 s.

viewer.kept_nothing: Saved for this visit only: this browser keeps nothing for this page.
viewer.subtitle: The model as its author left it: move the levers and run your version.

viewer.recorded_note: One replication, seed {seed}, recorded when this file was made.
viewer.cdn_offline: The engine could not start: {name} could not be downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net. This small file loads the browser runtime from the network when it opens; connect to the network and reload, or ask for the offline file.
viewer.cdn_insecure: The engine was not started: this browser has no way to check the downloaded file (it offers no crypto.subtle on a plain http address), so it was not run. This page must be opened from a file or over https.
viewer.cdn_tampered: The engine was not started: {name}, downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net, is not the file this page was made with (its SHA-256 differs), so it was not run. Ask the author for the offline file.
viewer.versions_cdn: Naga {naga} in this file; Python {python} (Pyodide {pyodide}) downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net and checked against the hashes in this file. Anyone with the file can read the model.

error.E_VIEWER_MODEL.message: This model cannot be shared as a viewer as it stands.
error.E_VIEWER_MODEL.fix: remove what the message names (agent Python, a LOGIC block, a plugin, a data source that was not frozen) or make the model smaller.
error.E_DASHBOARD_INPUT.message: An input points to something this model does not allow to change, or its kind does not fit the value found there.
error.E_DASHBOARD_INPUT.fix: ask the author to correct the input's path or kind.
error.E_DASHBOARD_DEFINITION.message: The definition of the inputs and results is malformed or over a limit.
error.E_DASHBOARD_DEFINITION.fix: ask the author to correct it: unknown keys, too many entries, a range that is not finite or text that is too long.
error.E_PARAM_TYPE.message: A block parameter has a value of the wrong type.
error.E_PARAM_TYPE.fix: set the input to a value of the type the parameter takes (a number, text or on/off).
error.E_PARAM_MISSING.message: A block lacks a parameter it requires.
error.E_PARAM_MISSING.fix: give the parameter a value; if an input cleared it, reset the input.
error.E_PARAM_UNKNOWN.message: A block has a parameter its type does not declare.
error.E_PARAM_UNKNOWN.fix: check the input's path: it names a parameter that does not exist for this block.
error.E_FIELD_RANGE.message: A number is outside the bounds this field allows.
error.E_FIELD_RANGE.fix: bring the input's value inside the range the field accepts (for example, not negative).
error.E_UNKNOWN_DISTRIBUTION.message: A distribution name is not one the engine knows.
error.E_UNKNOWN_DISTRIBUTION.fix: pick one of the distributions the model offers.
error.E_DISTRIBUTION_MISSING.message: A duration (a link delay, an uptime or a downtime) names no distribution.
error.E_DIST_PARAM_UNKNOWN.message: A distribution is given a parameter it does not take, so it would be ignored.
error.E_DIST_PARAM_UNKNOWN.fix: use only the parameters of that distribution (for example rate for Exponential).
error.E_DETERMINISTIC_NO_MEAN.message: The run is deterministic, but a distribution has no finite mean for its parameters.
error.E_DETERMINISTIC_NO_MEAN.fix: change the parameters (for example, a positive rate for Exponential) or use another distribution.
error.E_EXPRESSION.fix: check its syntax and that every name in it exists in the model.
error.E_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE.message: An expression uses a variable the model does not declare.
error.E_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE.fix: declare the variable, or correct its name.
error.E_VARIABLE_INITIAL.message: A variable's initial value is not a number, text or on/off.
error.E_VARIABLE_INITIAL.fix: give the variable one of those as its initial value.
error.E_BUFFER_CAPACITY.message: A buffer's capacity, or a queue capacity, is negative.
error.E_LEVEL_BOUNDS.message: A level's capacity, minimum or initial value is not a number, or the three do not agree.
error.E_LEVEL_BOUNDS.fix: make the minimum no greater than the initial value, and the initial value no greater than the capacity.
error.E_FLOW_EFFICIENCY.message: A flow's efficiency is outside the range above 0 up to 1.
error.E_FLOW_EFFICIENCY.fix: use a value above 0 and at most 1.
error.E_FLOW_MIN_RATE.message: A flow's minimum rate is not a number of 0 or more.
error.E_INITIAL_COUNT.message: The starting number of entities somewhere is negative or not a whole number.
error.E_INITIAL_COUNT.fix: use a whole number of 0 or more.
error.E_INITIAL_IN_SERVICE.message: More entities start in service than there are entities or units of the resource.
error.E_INITIAL_IN_SERVICE.fix: lower the number in service, or raise the count or the capacity.
error.E_INITIAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY.message: More entities start waiting at a block than it has places.
error.E_INITIAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY.fix: lower the starting number, or raise the queue capacity.
error.E_CREATE_ZERO_INTERARRIVAL.message: Arrivals come with no time between them and without end, so time could never advance.
error.E_CREATE_ZERO_INTERARRIVAL.fix: set a time between arrivals above 0, or limit the number of arrivals.
error.E_POPULATION_COUNT.message: A population's count is not a whole number of 0 or more, or its maximum is below the count.
error.E_POPULATION_COUNT.fix: use whole numbers, with the maximum at least the count.
error.E_POPULATION_FULL.message: A population reached its maximum and a new agent could not be created, so the run stopped.
error.E_POPULATION_FULL.fix: raise the population's maximum, or lower the rate at which agents are created.
error.E_ENTITY_COST.message: An entity type's holding cost is not a number of 0 or more.
error.E_SD_SETTINGS.message: The system dynamics settings are not valid: the step must be above 0, and the method and the time unit must be known.
error.E_SD_SETTINGS.fix: set a positive step and a method and a time unit the engine knows.
error.E_TIME_UNIT.message: A time unit is not one the engine knows.
error.E_TIME_UNIT.fix: use base or a known unit, such as seconds, minutes, hours or days.
error.E_SCENARIO_OVERRIDE.message: A change to the model has no path or no value.
error.E_SCENARIO_OVERRIDE.fix: give every change a path and a value.
